address: 21 Koh Kaew Village, Mittraphap Road, Pak Chong, Nakhon Ratchasima, 30130, Thailand
bio: Transporting diners back in time, this nostalgic eatery overflows with vintage collectibles – navigate your way to your table past retro movie posters, trinkets and antique toys. The signature minced beef curry with fresh coconut milk proves a perfect complement to the crispy fried gourami fish. With over 20 years in business, Banmai Chay Nam draws crowds with its delicious food and scenic views of Khao Yai, especially during peak season....
